mutation-survivors.summary: Surviving mutants and where they are, in about 15 lines
mutation-survivors.use_when: after ./verify --mutation, or whenever asked to raise the mutation score

arch-map.summary: Which slice owns what, and which slice may depend on which
arch-map.use_when: before touching code you have not seen, or when deciding where something belongs
arch-map.replaces: globbing the source tree and inferring the structure from file names

lexicon.summary: How a recurring problem was solved here before
lexicon.use_when: before deriving anything that feels like it should already be known
lexicon.replaces: rediscovering a tool quirk that cost somebody an afternoon

issue-context.summary: Validates an issue and prints an implementable brief, or refuses it
issue-context.use_when: the first step of /work, before any code is read
issue-context.replaces: reading an issue and guessing what the missing half meant

tool-mapping.summary: This registry. Lists tools by key so nobody reads the directory
tool-mapping.use_when: you suspect a script already exists for what you are about to do
tool-mapping.replaces: ls .claude/tools and opening each file to find out what it does

evals.summary: Does each gate say yes and no in the right places
evals.use_when: after changing a hook, a registry checker, or the ticket validator
evals.replaces: trusting a gate that has never been watched reject anything

pr.summary: Opens a pull request, or refuses one a human could not review
pr.use_when: the last step of /work. `gh pr create` is denied
pr.replaces: a reviewer checking by eye that every scenario is covered
